convert_cityscapes_to_coco: convert a cityscapes category ID to its COCO equivalent using the standard mapping lookup
convert_cityscapes_to_coco_with_rider: convert a cityscapes category ID to COCO treating rider as a person class
convert_cityscapes_to_coco_without_perso: convert a cityscapes category ID to COCO ignoring person and rider classes
convert_cityscapes_to_coco_all_random: convert all cityscapes category IDs to -1 for random initialization across all classes
review_category_mapping: review the cityscapes to COCO category ID mapping tables and their lookup strategies
